nvitk.core.click_backend
========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.core.click_backend

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Shared Click ``--backend`` option for nvitk CLIs and pipeline entry points.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.core.click_backend.set_default_backend
   nvitk.core.click_backend.apply_cli_backend
   nvitk.core.click_backend.backend_click_option
   nvitk.core.click_backend.sge_backend_env


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: set_default_backend(name: str, allow_fallback: bool = True) -> BackendName

   Alias for :func:`set_global_backend` (default ``allow_fallback=True`` for CLI use).


.. py:function:: apply_cli_backend(backend: str, *, allow_fallback: bool = True) -> str

   Apply *backend* from CLI (``cpu`` / ``gpu`` or ``numpy`` / ``cupy``).


.. py:function:: backend_click_option(*, default: str = 'gpu') -> Callable[[F], F]

   Decorator: add ``--backend cpu|gpu`` and call :func:`set_default_backend` before the command.


.. py:function:: sge_backend_env(src_bind: str, backend: str = 'gpu') -> dict[str, str]

   ``extra_env`` for SGE workers: ``PYTHONPATH`` plus ``NVITK_BACKEND``.
